name: mastermind
description: A desk for your Claude Code agents: who needs you, in every VS Code window.

commands.title: New Claude session on this file
Run the platform check's call file

mastermind.hookPort.description: The port Mastermind listens on for hook events and its VS Code windows — change it only when another program holds it; Mastermind then restarts on the new port and repoints every project watched from here.

mastermind.debugPort.description: VS Code's remote-debugging-port, which the panel's send, allow / deny and archive buttons and the Claude-panel memory reading use — leave it 0 (off) unless you turned that port on in argv.json, as the walkthrough does.

mastermind.startAtLogin.description: Start Mastermind when you log in to Windows, on this machine only — turn it on to find the panel waiting before you open VS Code.

mastermind.askToStart.description: A window that opens while Mastermind isn't running asks to start it — turn it off if you start Mastermind yourself.

mastermind.exePath.description: Mastermind.exe's full path on this machine — leave it empty to run the copy this extension carries, and set it only to run a build of your own.

include.description: Glob of the files the item shows on, from each workspace folder, e.g. docs/*.md — the folders before the first wildcard are the only ones searched.

exclude.description: Glob of the files left out, matched against each file's path under the include's fixed folder, where the search runs — start it with **/ to match at any depth, e.g. **/archive.md.

template.description: The prompt typed into the new session, unsent; {path} is the file's workspace-relative path.

mastermind.promptItem.markdownDescription: The explorer's right-click item, a new Claude session with `template` typed in, unsent, on files matching `include` minus `exclude` — fill `include` to show it, leave it empty for no item.

mastermind.newSessionAutoAllow.description: Every Claude session starts with auto-allow on — new, cleared and resumed ones, unless you turned it off on a resumed one's card — so turn it on only if you trust every session to run tools unasked; it needs Mastermind running when the session starts.

mastermind.relay.description: Mastermind moves handoffs between projects (the relay) — turn it on to have a handoff written in one project delivered to another.

mastermind.health.enabled.description: A status-bar item in each window shows its TypeScript, ESLint and Angular servers' and its Claude panel's memory once past their warning share, restarts a server in its error band on its own and marks the window on Mastermind's tray — turn it off if you don't want it.

mastermind.health.typescript.warningPerc.description: Share of the TypeScript server's heap cap from which the health item shows it — lower it to hear sooner.

mastermind.health.typescript.errorPercen.description: Share of the TypeScript server's heap cap from which the item turns red, the tray marks this window and an automatic restart becomes due — raise it to restart less often.

mastermind.health.typescript.autoRestart.description: Restart the TypeScript server on its own in its error band, once no file has been opened, changed or closed for the quiet wait and at most once per cooldown — turn it off to restart it only by hand.

mastermind.health.eslint.warningPercent.description: Share of the ESLint server's heap cap from which the health item shows it — lower it to hear sooner.

mastermind.health.eslint.errorPercent.description: Share of the ESLint server's heap cap from which the item turns red, the tray marks this window and an automatic restart becomes due — raise it to restart less often.

mastermind.health.eslint.autoRestart.description: Restart the ESLint server on its own in its error band, once no file has been opened, changed or closed for the quiet wait and at most once per cooldown — turn it off to restart it only by hand.

mastermind.health.angular.warningPercent.description: Share of the Angular server's heap cap from which the health item shows it — lower it to hear sooner.

mastermind.health.angular.errorPercent.description: Share of the Angular server's heap cap from which the item turns red, the tray marks this window and an automatic restart becomes due — raise it to restart less often.

mastermind.health.angular.autoRestart.description: Restart the Angular server on its own in its error band, once no file has been opened, changed or closed for the quiet wait and at most once per cooldown — turn it off to restart it only by hand.

mastermind.health.panel.warningPercent.description: Share of a Claude panel's heap cap, measured on this PC and read over the debug port, from which the health item shows it — lower it to hear sooner.

mastermind.health.panel.errorPercent.description: Share of a Claude panel's heap cap, measured on this PC and read over the debug port, from which the item turns red and the tray marks this window — the panel never reloads on its own, so raise it to be told later.

mastermind.health.quietSeconds.description: How long no file may be opened, changed or closed before a server in its error band restarts on its own — a restart mid-load orphans its loading indicator, so raise it if you see one left spinning.

mastermind.health.cooldownMinutes.description: The least time between two automatic restarts of one server — raise it if a server keeps restarting.

walkthroughs.title: Set up Agent Mastermind
walkthroughs.description: Start Mastermind, and turn on the debug port if you want the panel's send, allow / deny and archive actions.

steps.title: Start Mastermind
steps.description:
Mastermind runs as its own app beside VS Code — the tray icon, the panel, and the badge in every window.
[Start Mastermind](command:mastermind.start)

steps.title: Turn on the debug port (optional)
steps.description:
The panel's send, allow / deny and archive, and each window's Claude-panel memory reading, drive VS Code through its debug port — and so can any local process, which is fine on a machine only you use. Add "remote-debugging-port": "9222" to argv.json, set Mastermind's Debug Port to 9222, then quit every VS Code window and reopen.
[Open argv.json](command:workbench.action.configureRuntimeArguments)
[Open the Debug Port setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22mastermind.debugPort%22%5D)
